evidence: The standards lever is concrete: 196 of the 744 non-MONDO diseases map through MONDO xrefs, which would raise MONDO coverage from 1,176 to 1,372 of 1,920.
metric: 1,920 diseases; 1,176 with MONDO; 744 without; 196 xref-mappable; 548 unmapped (UMLS 364, MESH 112, NAME 64, DOID 6, MIM 2); 192 distinct targets; xref index 146,038 keys
observation: A MONDO cross-reference index was built from the pinned ontology and matched against diseases that lack a MONDO id. A fifth of the unmapped diseases resolve through xrefs, while the rest are UMLS, MeSH or name-derived keys that the index cannot reach.
subject: F-79
title: MONDO cross-references would raise disease identity coverage to 1,372 / 1,920
